entities.title: Sound
entities.summary: Whether sound is off, remembered in this browser.
entities.details: Read when the page opens, written whenever M or the SOUND button toggles it. Blocked storage starts with sound on and remembers nothing.

entities.title: Online match
entities.summary: The match this page was opened to join, from the address.
entities.details: Anything else is ignored and the page shows the title. Leaving the match removes it from the address, so a reload doesn't join it again.

entities.title: Online mode
entities.summary: Co-op or versus for an online game this page's browser starts as host.
entities.details: Only the host's reading counts: it is sent in the start message, and every other page plays the mode it receives.
